opening.title: Mobile and Frontend Product Engineer
opening.summary: Ship the Nasfam Pay web and mobile apps: React and React Native, our UI system, accessibility, performance and testing.
opening.about:
Customers use Nasfam Pay on the web and in our Android app. Both handle real money, so every screen has to be fast, clear and correct, including on a slow connection and a modest phone.

You will build features end to end on both clients, look after the shared UI system, and make the test and release process something the team can rely on.
owns: Features on the React web app and the React Native mobile app.
The UI system: components, patterns and how they stay consistent.
Accessibility and performance on real devices and connections.
Frontend tests and the release checks that run before shipping.
responsibilities: Build screens from design to production, including loading, empty and error states.
Keep money flows such as buying, withdrawing and PIN entry correct and well tested.
Improve performance and reliability on low-end devices and slow networks.
Review code and improve the frontend architecture over time.
requirements: Several years building production React applications.
Experience shipping a React Native app to real users.
Care for detail in UI, accessibility and performance.
Testing habits: you prove a screen works rather than assume it.
niceToHave: Expo, EAS and app store releases.
Tailwind or a design system you helped build.
Experience with fintech or crypto products.
success: In your first month you have shipped a change on both web and mobile.
Within your first quarter you own a product area and its tests.
Releases are calmer, with fewer regressions reaching customers.
